mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, goods_id, coupon_id, discount_amount, goods_num, goods_price, total_amount, status, order_type) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{goodsId}, #{couponId}, #{discountAmount}, #{goodsNum}, #{goodsPrice}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{orderType})
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.goods_id, g.pet_name, o.goods_num, o.goods_price, o.total_amount, o.discount_amount, o.status, o.order_type, o.create_time FROM orders o JOIN pet_goods g ON g.id = o.goods_id AND g.deleted = 0 WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, order_no, user_id, goods_id, coupon_id, discount_amount, goods_num, goods_price, total_amount, status, order_type, create_time, deleted FROM orders WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
